directorProcedureRecord.procedure:
Action; native120 feet; V/S/F; native rank9/base26RP through Cleric/Druid/Wizard Necromancy. Choose one perceived living creature with a source-qualified ordinary life/normal-HP interface in range and line of effect. NEW evaluate its actual current normalHP at resolution: strictly below50 qualifies;50 does not. Temporary HP is not counted. On qualification attempt direct death with no invented attack/save/damage. An eligible would-die replacement precedes actual death; a prevention means no reserve. A later independent death is not attributed retroactively. A paid threshold failure has no fallback and discloses no exact HP.

Only an actual eligible death caused by this cast opens the reserve-capture stage. NEW select optionA: a source-owned finite spell-payment token, not a claim of soul ownership, destruction, memory access, an afterlife location or an additional resurrection prison. Still require an actual identity/soul record establishing that this capture is permitted. An unavailable/unknown soul fact creates a capture hold, not a free token. Existing source-bound custody, an express soul-capture bar, Hunted Death (NEW local no-reward choice), and an actual summon/no-resource-farming rule prevent capture; death remains resolved. This local restriction supplies no escape from Hunt finality. Ordinary future return uses its own gates, and token use/expiry neither causes nor prevents that return.

NEW each lawful capture creates one nontransferable5RP-maximum token tied to caster identity, victim identity, generating cast/death event and the end of that caster's next legally completed long rest. Concurrent distinct lawful tokens may coexist; there is no invented per-rest capture cap. Choose at most ONE token for ONE eligible spell commitment. Compute that spell's real price first, then allocate0..min(5,tokenRemaining,eligibleBaseRP) to its base-RP component; mandatory extra RP, Dissonance surcharge and nonspell costs must still be paid from their actual sources. No reserve stacks with another reserve on that cast. A zero allocation does not consume it. A positive allocation commits and consumes the entire token before interruption; unused remainder is lost, and counter/failure does not restore it. A legal base-price0 cast cannot consume a token merely to refresh it. It cannot pay a nonspell class rite, move into ordinary RP, transfer through an item/body, or duplicate through save/load. Caster death suspends ability to cast but does not reset an existing token's original next-long-rest endpoint.

The native positive capture/payment obligation is NOT demonstrated by inventing soul availability. This return retains the positive capture, subsequent paid use/counter, concurrency and expiry demonstrations as precisely linked held continuations wherever the requisite actual token cannot be established from supplied evidence. The selected operational rule is complete as a proposal; acceptance remains blocked on that evidence.

Return217 reassessment: the token accounting, one-token-per-spell rule, no ownership/return prison selection, strict49/50 boundary and exact capture exclusions are director-selected spell-local rules. The remaining hold is evidentiary only: establish one source-authorized, unbound capture-eligible victim lifecycle/identity, then complete actual token creation, one-spell payment, counter nonrefund, remainder and concurrent expiry. A participant choosing Pact return is not permission to infer that another identity can be captured. Neither an arbitrary new global capture-permission gate nor a new soul doctrine is selected.

procedure.procedureText:
Action; V/S/F; native rank9/base26RP through Cleric/Druid/Wizard Necromancy. Preserve the native120-foot/Instantaneous fields as source evidence. NEW optionA resolves YOUR/UPONDEATH as a prospective SELF-only pact, not a remote120-foot resurrection: the living caster arms their own identity. A currently Dead identity cannot newly cast/arm it. NEW the application is persistent, nonconcentration, until spent, successfully replaced, or lawfully ended. It grants no current HP/RP and consumes normal casting costs/cadence at arming.

NEW one active Eternal Pact family record per recipient identity. A later successful paid self-cast replaces the older unspent application without refund and without adding another return. Countering a new cast leaves an earlier independent pact intact. The first actual death after arming consumes the chosen application exactly once, including when its expression is suppressed or the return is blocked. A would-die prevention is not death, does not consume the pact and does not restore RP. Do not insert a return before the fatal event, its prevention windows and its actual body/remains consequences finish. Resolve actual death, Soul Bind conversion/Hunted Death and source body aftermath first; only then attempt this return. A suppression-skipped trigger is lost, not pending for later replay.

NEW at that single post-event checkpoint require the same willing dead identity, the actual original body/remains sufficient and viable for return at its existing location, legal physical placement, no occupied duplicate living identity, and every applicable identity/soul/return blocker.
